statement: Because the T011 admitted envelope cannot link the gRPC runtime (`T030-GAP-02`, `T031-GAP-01`), the client **shall** realize the accepted generated message and method contract over the bounded, host-protected local-IPC framing bound 1:1 to the T030 generated method names; it **shall** add no admitted dependency and **shall not** claim a linked gRPC runtime. The deferred gRPC transport runtime **shall** be recorded as an explicit gap (`T032-GAP-01`).
title: T032 requirement 017

successor_disposition.successor: The T039 successor adds a separate linked gRPC gateway component (xverse_xcom_tool_gateway_grpc) that compiles and links the admitted gRPC runtime and both generated services (ToolGateway, GatewayLiveness). That component supersedes the deferred-transport premise for the platform gateway only.
successor_disposition.component_distinction: The T032 synthetic client keeps its framed local-IPC transport and does not claim a linked gRPC runtime; the successor gateway capability is not a T032 claim.
successor_disposition.ref002: unchanged; no deferred REF-002 target is promoted
